blockingIssues.description: Dev Mongo ownership normalization is incomplete in the refresh path, so sync can still require a root-only workaround and fail the intended non-root dev flow.
The Langfuse NODE_OPTIONS change is not scoped to dev and alters stable-rail runtime behavior, violating the feature requirement to keep stable untouched.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify runtime-only validation expectations under constrained hosts: when full test/build/lint is intentionally deferred to milestone scrutiny, require explicit rationale and a runtime-focused validation minimum set.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: restore-dev-langfuse-and-runtime-readiness review observed repeated skill deviation notes about skipping full-suite test execution for runtime-only changes under host memory constraints.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add an explicit checkpoint for post-restore ownership verification (including non-root mismatches) when changing sync/restore flows to remove root-only workarounds.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: reconcile-root-runtime-config-and-install-patch-seams review found pre-restore-only ownership normalization was insufficient and required immediate follow-up hardening in commit 4fa0e8018.

rejectedObservations.observation: Add a new library rule distinguishing guard behavior verification from end-to-end flow verification for bundle/sync scripts.
